events.message: Target E-commerce shop (16 services) at http://192.168.49.2 (namespace flexascale-apps)
Application data reset (2 configured steps)

Resetting replicas to minimum (HPAs held at their minimum during the reset)
Holding HPAs at their minimum for 318 s more: the HPA downscale window since the previous load must expire for a comparable start
